title: Sleepy jellyfish
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

    <radialGradient id='bell' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd6f2'/>

  <!-- little mouth -->
  <path d='M47 54 Q50 57 53 54' stroke='#5a2a63' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M74 20 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M82 10 h5 l-5 5 h5' stroke='#c9f0ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
